claim: Traces written by independent instrumentation (OpenInference on the OpenTelemetry SDK) for a different framework (LlamaIndex), exported as OTLP JSON, were imported losslessly (32/32) into the common Glassbox representation, and the unchanged diff engine reached Experiment 1's conclusions on the same stale-index fault: localisation 4/4, specificity 4/4, recovery 8/8, determinism 8/8. Glassbox traces exported to OTLP JSON passed the official OTLP protobuf schema (32/32).
integrity_note: Integrity is not truth: a verifying manifest shows these files are unchanged since packaging; it does not show the experiment or the claim is correct.
scope: Pre-registered (protocol 5a5d2da, addenda 7fcc028 including a disclosed toy-corpus code smoke test, code 226a4eb). Stack B is retrieval only (no LLM call), deterministic, one framework, one injected fault, pipeline and corpus written by the author, cause known by construction. The schema check uses opentelemetry-proto 1.45.1 and is not a test against a live OTLP collector. Single author, not independently reproduced.
